acquisition_method.evidence: The MS was operated in a data-dependent mode, automatically switching between MS and MS2 acquisition, with mass resolution of 70,000 and 17,500, respectively.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: cysteine residues were blocked by reduction and alkylation using tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine and iodoacetamide, respectively.

cleavage_agent.evidence: In-gel digestion was performed using trypsin

fragmentation_method.evidence: Up to ten most intense ions were fragmented per every full MS scan by higher-energy collisional dissociation.

instrument.evidence: LC-MS/MS was performed on an EASY nanoLC coupled to a Q Exactive Plus Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap Mass Spectrometer.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: Interacting proteins were identified and quantified by nano-LC-MS/MS

mass_analyzer.evidence: Q Exactive Plus Hybrid Quadrupole-Orbitrap Mass Spectrometer
